eyebrowText: WHY TALK THERAPY FROM GROVEWOOD MENTAL HEALTH?
title: Since 2009, we've helped thousands along the Wasatch Front get the change they wanted
description: Grovewood Mental Health (formerly known as Giles & Associates Family Psychology) was formed in 2009. Since then we've helped thousands of individuals, couples, families, and teens all along the Wasatch Front. We take our role as a change agent very seriously and are honored to be trusted by so many.
